mechanism: Criteria check can-cook output values but do not require unchanged store bytes or absence of store creation for this query. List-command byte checks and failed-cook atomicity apply to other operations and do not cover it.

evidence.role: Relevant current target region; absence claims must also inspect the complete target

mustNotClaim: A failure to execute an existing criterion proves it is absent
A failed-cook criterion covers successful cook consumption
Correct output values alone establish absence of query file side effects
